Climate change is another vital factor impacting the current way of doing business. According to recent studies, 97% of organisations have already been negatively influenced by climate change, and the majority of CEOs are worried about the effects that the main environmental challenges could have in the future on their economic sector. Climate change influences business in 6 ways:
: Climate change increases the likelihood of extreme weather events (floods, drought…), which can damage businesses.
Rules preventing pollution means that companies producing high levels of CO2 emissions must invest in upgrading their facilities.
Most customers prefer buying products and services sustainably produced by companies active in reducing their environmental impact.
4. Changes in the availability of resources
: Global warming causes a decrease in the availability of certain resources (e.g. a drought may cause a shortage of some crops). If resources are scarce, their price tends to increase.
As the climate changes on a global level, also the demand for certain goods, services and facilities will change.
: With the change in weather patterns, also working conditions in some sectors tend to worsen (i.e. working outdoors in extremely hot weather).
